title: flt.c_notch~
description: `flt.c_notch~` calculates biquad coefficients for a band-reject (notch) filter from a control signal, center frequency, and quality factor. Its five outlets provide the `b0`, `b1`, `b2`, `a1`, and `a2` coefficients for use with an object such as `flt.biquad~`; frequency ranges from 20 to 20000 Hz and Q from 0.01 to 100.
